page: OVHcloud t2-45 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance belonging to the Cloud GPU family, provisioned via KVM virtualization. The configuration is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6226R processor clocked at 2.9 GHz, delivering 15 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core (no hyperthreading). Hardware instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI. The system is equipped with 45.0 GB of system RAM (3.0 GB per core) and includes 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside a 2 Gbps baseline network interface. Dedicated acceleration is provided by one NVIDIA Volta V100S GPU with 32 GB of VRAM.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong acceleration in machine learning inference tasks, particularly on smaller and mid-sized model architectures. Prompt processing on a 7B model reaches 1442.57 tokens per second, and text generation achieves 129.57 tokens per second, ranking in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. On a small 135M parameter model, prompt throughput reaches 19232.39 tokens per second. However, performance degrades on large models like 70B variants, where prompt processing drops to 16.12 tokens per second and text generation is unsupported due to the 32 GB GPU VRAM constraint. General CPU and system metrics, including Geekbench (1254.0 single-core, 9062.0 multi-core) and PassMark (22125.89 CPU score), consistently fall within the middle 50 percent.

This hardware balance makes the t2-45 cost efficient for workloads that require dedicated GPU throughput without needing latest-generation silicon or massive system memory. It is appropriate for deep learning inference, model fine-tuning of small to medium architectures, GPU-accelerated data processing, and visual rendering tasks that fit within a 32 GB VRAM footprint.
description: OVHcloud t2-45 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server equipped with 15 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6226R processor running at 2.9 GHz, 45.0 GB of RAM, and 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It integrates a dedicated NVIDIA Volta V100S GPU featuring 32 GB of VRAM and provides 2 Gbps of network bandwidth. In benchmarks, the t2-45 delivers top-tier performance for medium-sized language model inference, achieving 1442.57 tokens per second for prompt processing and 129.57 tokens per second for text generation on 7B parameter models. CPU compute and memory throughput metrics consistently sit within the mid-tier baseline. The t2-45 is suited for deep learning inference, fine-tuning small to mid-sized models, and GPU-driven numerical computation.
